name: Sunadokei
source:
A corpse of a man is found at the hotel beach. The protagonist is an aspiring detective who agrees to solve this case while chasing after pretty girls staying at the hotel.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-may-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
酒店海滩上发现了一具男性尸体。主人公是一名有志成为侦探的人，他答应在追逐酒店里漂亮女孩的同时解决这起案件。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-may-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
